summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError, following the seven-step procedure in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, one parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes (including the rdf:nil/empty-list case and the Literal case), a non-node test for None and a plain string, and a test confirming the graph is unchanged after parsing. Test results: test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py and test/test_path.py together, 43 passed, run with the shared venv Python. All new lines are within 88 columns. Not verified: mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. The type-ignore on the `with pytest.raises(expected):` line was left out; if the checker flags it, that is the line to adjust. Nothing was committed.
